description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git submodule handling, specifically testing 'git am' (apply mailbox) operations with submodules, including setup, configuration, and execution of various test scenarios.

methods.name: am
methods.description: Performs 'git am' with the specified patch, optionally with '3way' merge option, handling submodules.

methods.name: am_3way
methods.description: Performs 'git am --3way' with the specified patch, used for applying patches with conflict resolution.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_func
methods.description: Function to test submodule switching behavior with provided method.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Executes the sequence of Git commands to test patch application and submodule updates, comparing the result.
